ignoreCommand: BASE="${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-}"; if [ -z "$BASE" ] || ! git cat-file -e "$BASE" 2>/dev/null; then BASE=HEAD^; fi; git rev-parse "$BASE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; git diff --name-only "$BASE" HEAD | grep -qvE '^(v2/scripts/|\.github/|\.planning/|v2/docs/)|\.md$|/__tests__/|\.test\.tsx?$|^v2/vitest\.' && exit 1 || exit 0
